arStrings.szText: Nightmares of the past have returned to haunt the present. {c_highlight}Explore key memories from all of Diablo's history.{/c}
{c_highlight}Waking Nightmares{/c} are seasonal dungeons. Some are found in {c_highlight}specific locations{/c} while others appear at {c_highlight}random{/c} across Sanctuary.
